subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `PluginStatusProvider` / `registerStatusProvider` Plugin SDK seam now, and should it land as API-only before TUI rendering is designed?
rationale: This is a new public plugin contract rather than a broken existing behavior, and the linked PR leaves explicit API-shape and footer-rendering choices for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Narrow API First
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the API/registry seam and track TUI rendering decisions separately with the broader footer work.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Footer Design
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53774 until footer template, ordering, and provider-display policy are designed together.

options.title: Decline Core SDK Surface
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers want footer customization to stay outside the native Plugin SDK and avoid adding another public API method.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow API First
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the API/registry seam and track TUI rendering decisions separately with the broader footer work.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history signal for Plugin SDK public-surface direction is repeated work on plugin SDK/API builder files and docs.
